newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS in talks to sell consumer credit unit.
newsitem.headline: UBS in talks to sell consumer credit unit.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland said it was in talks to sell its domestic consumer credit and consumer leasing subsidiary Aufina.
The subsidiary specialises in car financing.
"We are in talks, but we cannot say with whom we are talking," UBS spokesman Robert Vogler said.
According to a report in the Swiss daily Aargauer Zeitung, UBS is negotiating to sell the Aufina unit to General Motors Corp of the U.S.

Aufina has a balance sheet total of about 1.82 billion Swiss francs. It is the third largest player in the domestic consumer credit segment with a market share of 17.7 percent and it reported a net profit last year of 8.5 million francs, according to a report by the Swiss news agency SDA.
